additional_info.subject: WG: Sicharge D Pfarrer-Maybaum-Weg Köln
additional_info.body:
Dear level two,
Can you please do me a favor and open a new ticket based on Jonas email below?
Please make sure to include the attached pictures as well.
The underlying Sicharge D serial number is:
Y2/S7 313757457009
Customer name: TankE GmbH
Brief description: it looks like during installation parts have been broken. Expert support to please look at the picture and advise if the charger can be fixed on site and if the needed spare parts can be ordered.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Sascha Theil
Von:
Keller, Jonas André (YU GER CS P EVCI) <jonas.keller@yunextraffic.com>
Datum:
Donnerstag, 21. November 2024 um 20:39
An:
Theil, Sascha (RC-DE SI E CS) <sascha.theil@siemens.com>, m.litzke@tanke.io <m.litzke@tanke.io>
Betreff:
Sicharge D Pfarrer-Maybaum-Weg Köln
Sehr geehrter Herr Litzke,
Entschuldigen Sie das ich so spät er die E-Mail schicke.
Zusammengefasst nochmal das Problem:
Der Charger wurde vermutlich bei der Montage beschädigt so das im oberen hinteren Teil die Bolzen an der Klappe abgerissen wurden. Dies ist mir beim Demontieren direkt aufgefallen. Somit ist die hintere Klappe nicht vollständig gesichert und es können dritte Zugang zum Charger und somit zu spannungsführenden Teilen erhalten.
Anhand der Bilder sieht man das die Gewindegänge in den die Ösen befestigt werden, um den Charger anzuheben vollständig vom Dach bedeckt werden. Somit musste man, sofern der Charger angehoben wurde Zugang dazu bekommen. Dies geschieht über die besagte Klappe und somit auch über die beschädigten Teile.
Außerdem konnte das Erdungskabel nicht richtig befestigt werden da am Kabel selbst eine Steckvorrichtung ist, diese aber an der Klappe selbst fehlt. Somit ist der Charger nicht ausreichend geerdet.
@Theil, Sascha (RC-DE SI E CS)
gibt es eine Möglichkeit die defekten Sachen einzeln zu erneuern ?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Jonas Keller

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398977-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S7 313757457009] During installation parts have been broken CRM:00641000962
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr.
David Correia,
I hope this message finds you well.
As reported by the regional team:
The charger was likely damaged during assembly, resulting in the bolts on the flap in the upper rear section being torn off. This issue became apparent during dismantling. Consequently, the rear flap is not fully secured, allowing third parties potential access to the charger and its live components.
Based on the provided pictures, it is evident that the threads where the eyelets are attached for lifting the charger are completely covered by the roof. Therefore, if the charger was lifted, access to these threads must have been obtained via the rear flap, which has been compromised.
Additionally, the grounding cable could not be properly attached. The cable itself features a plug device, but the corresponding receptacle is missing on the flap. As a result, the charger is insufficiently grounded.
Please review these points and let me know if any further clarification is needed. If so, we can schedule a team discussion with RC to clarify them.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar

additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
After assessing these topics with the Quality Control team, here are our thoughts below highlighted:
The charger was likely damaged during assembly, resulting in the bolts on the flap in the upper rear section being torn off. This issue became apparent during dismantling. Consequently, the rear flap is not fully secured, allowing third parties potential access to the charger and its live components.
The bolts could be broken in factory assembly process, but it would be detected easily and a new housing would be used.
Based on the provided pictures, it is evident that the threads where the eyelets are attached for lifting the charger are completely covered by the roof. Therefore, if the charger was lifted, access to these threads must have been obtained via the rear flap, which has been compromised.
The roof is not assembled in the factory.
Additionally, the grounding cable could not be properly attached. The cable itself features a plug device, but the corresponding receptacle is missing on the flap. As a result, the charger is insufficiently grounded.
Please confirm that you have received a bag with the grounding cable fixation pieces as per the pictures below
For further questions, we are available.
Thank you.
With best regards,
